extracted.intended_audience: beneficiaries and communication officers of EU-funded Civil Protection actions / projects
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and mandatory visibility/communication rules for preparing and publishing press releases and other communication materials for Civil Protection actions funded by the European Union.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1. INTRODUCTION
rubrics_metrics.description: Introductory section establishing scope and purpose of the Communication and Visibility Manual for Civil Protection Actions funded by the EU.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2. EU VISiBILITY
rubrics_metrics.description: Overall requirements and principles for making EU funding visible in communications and materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2.1.1 Derogations
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances and rules under which normal visibility requirements may be derogated from.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2.2 Funding statement
rubrics_metrics.description: How to include the mandatory funding statement acknowledging EU funding in materials and communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2.4 Examples of EU emblem and funding statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Illustrative examples showing correct use of the EU emblem together with the funding statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2.4.1 Display panels
rubrics_metrics.description: Visibility rules specific to display panels (e.g., size, placement of emblem/funding statement).

rubrics_metrics.name: 2.4.2 Vehicles, clothing, and equipment
rubrics_metrics.description: Visibility requirements for branding of vehicles, clothing, and equipment (EU emblem and funding statement placement/size).

rubrics_metrics.name: 2.4.3 Banners
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for banners used in project events, including emblem and funding statement treatment.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2.4.4 Publications
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for print publications (reports, brochures) regarding EU visibility, emblem and funding statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2.4.5 Digital assets
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for digital assets (web pages, digital brochures) to show the EU emblem and funding statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2.4.6 Stationery, business cards, letterheads, etc.
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on applying visibility requirements to stationery and small-format printed items.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3. COMMUNICATION
rubrics_metrics.description: High-level communication strategy and mandatory principles to follow for project communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3.1 Narrative
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on the communication narrative to be used (key messages, tone, storytelling) for visibility of EU-funded actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3.2 Objectives
rubrics_metrics.description: Communication objectives that materials and activities should pursue (e.g., awareness, transparency, stakeholder engagement).

rubrics_metrics.name: 3.3 Audience
rubrics_metrics.description: Identification and tailoring of communication to target audiences and stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3.4 Approach
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommended overall approach and principles for implementing communication and visibility activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3.5 Activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Catalog of possible communication activities (press engagement, digital, events) and how they should meet visibility rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3.5.1 Press and media engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for interacting with press and media, ensuring EU visibility is respected.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3.5.1.1. Press releases
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific rules and guidance for preparing, approving and publishing press releases for EU-funded Civil Protection actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3.5.1.2. Press conferences
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for organizing press conferences, including branding, statements and visibility obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3.5.1.3 Media clearance
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and criteria for media clearance of materials and messages prior to publication or broadcast.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3.5.1.4 Journalist and digital content multipliers visits
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for hosting journalists and content creators (visits, site tours) while ensuring required visibility and acknowledgements.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3.5.2 Digital communication
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for digital channels (websites, social media, multimedia) to ensure EU visibility and consistent messaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3.5.2.1. Web communication
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for website content, emblem placement, funding statements, and web-specific accessibility/visibility rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3.5.2.2. Social media
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for use of social media (posts, profiles, hashtags) including how to acknowledge EU funding and use branding assets.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3.5.2.3. Photos
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for photographs used in communications (credits, consent, emblem overlay where applicable).

rubrics_metrics.name: 3.5.2.4. Videos
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for video content production, captioning, opening/closing frames with EU emblem and funding statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3.6 Measuring impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Principles and possible indicators for measuring the reach and impact of communication and visibility activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3.6.1 Minimum requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Minimum mandatory visibility actions and elements that must be implemented for compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3.6.2 Additional requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Extra visibility actions or enhanced requirements that may apply in specific contexts or where specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3.7 Non-compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Consequences, remedies and reporting procedures when visibility rules are not followed.

rubrics_metrics.name: 4. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on copyright, use rights and ownership for materials produced under EU-funded actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: 4.2 The EU's right to use communication material
rubrics_metrics.description: Statement of the EU's rights to reuse and reproduce material produced under funded projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: 4.3 Moral rights or third-party rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Considerations and obligations regarding third-party rights, moral rights and necessary permissions/consents.

rubrics_metrics.name: 4.5 Templates
rubrics_metrics.description: Provision and use of official templates (e.g., letterheads, press release templates) to ensure consistent visibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: 4.6 Disclaimers
rubrics_metrics.description: Required disclaimers and wording to be used in communications where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: 5. USEFUL LINKS AND CONTACT POINTS
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference contacts and further resources to support compliance with visibility rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: 5.1 Contact for questions
rubrics_metrics.description: Designated contact point(s) for queries about visibility and communications requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: 5.2 Visibility Guidelines and Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: List of additional guidance documents, assets, and resources to implement visibility measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: 5.3 Intellectual Property Rights (resources)
rubrics_metrics.description: Links and resources specific to managing IPR in communications for EU-funded projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: 5.4 Regulations and Decision
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference to the legal/regulatory basis and official decisions underpinning the visibility requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Code of conduct
rubrics_metrics.description: Behavioural and ethical expectations for communication activities (may cover media relations, use of images, privacy).

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyright Used in this Manual
rubrics_metrics.description: Attribution and copyright statements covering materials used within the manual itself.
